posts.body_html: I've ordered many times from Mike Wang over the past few years. He is THE US source for location Data Sarracenia species (Which is my primary interest) and is probably the closest equivalent to Mike King of the UK. His plants are always beautiful, meticulously labeled, washed, ready to grow and look like fresh washed vegetables. He is extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of Sarracenia cultivation and forms and is very responsive to inquiries and questions. He also makes excellent suggestions for plant choices,many of which are not listed. Extremely reliable and a pleasure to do business with. So if you're looking for location Data Sarracenia in the US this should be your first stop.

I'd highly recommend buying from Mike Wang and I will again.

posts.body_html:
I purchased a couple of Sarracenia from Mike at a recommendation from a friend. Mike was prompt with his response and was very helpful throughout the process (From narrowing down selections to find which would work best, recommendations based off of experience, and general knowledge and pro tips). It was awesome because I had inquired about a couple of plants that were out of stock but he has recently come into more between updates. That was cool because I was able to get an amazing black alata as well as a flava I had my eye on. Once I had placed the order, Mike had them sent out immediately the next day. Shipping was very fast and when I opened the box, it was a pleasant surprise. Mike's plants are very healthy and cared for and you can see the effort he puts into it. It was also awesome that he packaged a couple of extra plants that were close to some others on my list. It was like Christmas lol.

Mike is a good guy who cares about what he does and the satisfaction of the people who purchase from him. I'm very glad that my friend recommended him to me. It was cool to have hundreds to choose from with unique qualities over that typical Judith Hindle or Minor you see on a regular CP site. I'll definitely order from him again. I'll probably run out of space before I know it. lol

Thanks again Mike.

I have made two purchases from Mike this year and am thoroughly pleased with my Sarracenia and overall buying experience. You get great value for quality plants. I'm newish to growing CP's and felt comfortable asking questions and talking through specifics about the plants I'm interested in when buying within a certain price range. 

I made separate purchases. The first was a small sized flava ornata 'Improved Black Veins'. Great size and color. More recently, I ordered a small alata Stone Co., MS clone and was also impressed with the shape and size of this fella for the price. Each time they arrived across the country in less than a week. They were always well packaged and looked great. 

Each time, I was also surprised and grateful to receive some wonderful freebies that are now rocking it in my collection

Do yourself a favor and get some dang Sarracenia from Mike.
